m: सं-ता˚नार्थम् ind. for the sake of (begetting) progeny, Mn. iii, 96
सं—˚तानीय (?), Hcat.
सं-तान m. (ifc. f(आ). ) continued succession, continuance, continuity, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
an uninterrupted series, continuous flow, Kālid.
ramification, Suśr.
a sinew or ligature (of an animal), TS.
coherence, connection, transition (in recitation &c.), ŚrS.; TUp.
a continuous train of thought, Sarvad.
= संधि, Kām.
one of the five trees of Indra's heaven, the Kalpa tree or its flower, Hariv.
N. of a son of Rudra, MārkP.
of a place, Cat.
(pl.) N. of a partic. class of worlds, R.
सं-तान m. n. continuous succession, lineage, race, family, offspring, son or daughter, Nir.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं-तान n. a partic. mythical weapon, R.
a: संतानः --नं — 1 Stretching, extending, extension, expanse, spread; Ś. 7. 8. --2 Continuity, continuous flow or line, succession, continuance; अच्छिन्नामलसंतानाः Ku. 6. 69; संतानवाहीनि दुःखानि U. 4. 8. --3 Family, race. --4 Progeny, offspring, issue; संतानार्थाय विधये R. 1. 34; संतानकामाय राज्ञे 2. 65, 18. 52. --5 One of the five trees of Indra's paradise. --Comp. --संधिः a peace cemented by family alliance (as by giving a daughter in marriage &c.).

m: सं-तान—दीपिका f. N. of wk.
सं-तान—गण-पति m. a form of Gaṇeśa (worshipped to obtain progeny), W.
सं-तान—गो-पाल m. a form of Kṛṣṇa (worshipped to obtain progeny, also N. of a Kāvya), Cat.
सं-तान—गो-पा˚ल-विधि m. N. of wk.
सं-तान—ज mfn. sprung from the race of (gen.; with सुत m. = ‘the son of’), Hariv.
सं˚-तान˚काकीर्ण mfn. strewn with celestial flowers (cf. prec.), MW.
सं˚-तान˚कारण्य n. N. of a place, Bālar.
सं˚-तानक mf(इका)n. stretching, spreading, who or what spreads, W.
सं˚-तानक m. one of the five trees of Indra's heaven, the Kalpa tree or its flower, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of partic. worlds, R.
a: संतानकः — One of the five trees of Indra's paradise or its flower; Ku. 6. 46, 7. 3; Śi. 6. 67.

m: सं˚-तान˚क-मय mf(ई)n. consisting of flowers of the Kalpa tree, Ragh.
सं-तान—कर्मन् n. the act of producing offspring, Nir.
सं-तान—कर्तृ m. a producer of offspring, ib.
सं-तान—प्रद-सूर्य-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
सं-तान—राम-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
सं-तान—संधि m. a peace cemented by family alliance (by giving a daughter in marriage &c.), Kām.; Hit.
सं-तान—संहिता f. N. of wk.
सं-तान—वर्धन mfn. propagating a family, Yājñ.
सं-तान—वत् mfn. possessing offspring, MBh.
सं-तान—विवेकावलि f. N. of wk.
सं˚-तानिका (इका), f. a cobweb, Suśr.
cream, coagulated milk, ib.
froth, foam, L.
the blade of a knife or sword, L.
N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, MBh.
a: संतानिका — 1 Froth, foam. --2 Cream. --3 A cob-web. --4 The blade of a knife or sword.

m: सं—˚तानिक mf(ई)n. made from flowers of the Kalpa tree (as a garland), R.
सं—˚तानिक m. pl. N. of partic. worlds (v.l. सांत्˚), R.
सं—˚तानिक n. (with प्रजापतेः) N. of a Sāman (v.l. संतनिक), ĀrṣBr.
सं—˚तानिन् m. the subject of an uninterrupted train of thought, Sarvad.
सं—˚तानिनी (इनी), f. the upper part of milk, cream, L.
सं-ताप m. (ifc. f(आ). ) becoming very hot, great or burning heat, glow, fire, ŚBr. &c. &c.
affliction, pain, sorrow, anguish, distress (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to be distressed about [gen.]’, or ‘to cause pain’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
self-mortification, remorse, repentance, penance, MBh.; Kir.
a: संतापः — 1 Heat, great heat, inflammation; Māl. 3. 4. --2 Distress, torment, suffering, torture, agony, anguish; संतापसंततिमहाव्यसनाय तस्यामासक्तमेतदनपेक्षितहेतु चेतः Māl. 1. 23; न संतापच्छेदो हिमसरसि वा चंद्रमसि वा 1. 31; Ś. 3. --3 Passion, rage. --4 Remorse, repentance; Pt. 1. 109. --5 Penance, fatigues of penance, mortification of the body; संतापे दिशतु शिवः शिवां प्रसक्तिं Ki. 5. 50.

m: सं-ताप—हारक mfn. removing heat, cooling, comforting. (Śak.)
सं-ताप—हर mfn. removing heat, cooling, comforting. (Daś.)
सं-ताप—कारिन् mfn. causing pain or affliction (Kathās.)
सं-ताप—कर mfn. causing pain or affliction (Suśr.)
सं-˚तापन mfn. burning, paining, afflicting (comp.), BhP.
सं-˚तापन m. N. of one of the arrows of Kāma-deva, L.
of a demon possessing children, Hariv.
of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
सं-˚तापन n. the act of burning, paining, afflicting, exciting passion, W.
N. of a partic. mythical weapon, R.
a: संतापन — a. (नी f.) Burning, inflaming. --नः N. of one of the 5 arrows of Cupid. --नं 1 Burning, scorching. --2 Paining, afflicting. --3 Exciting passion.

m: सं-ताप—वत् mfn. afflicted with pain, sorrowful, Kathās.
सं-˚तापित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made very hot, burnt, scorched, tormented, pained, afflicted, wearied, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संतापित — p. p. Heated, afflicted, tormented &c.

m: सं-˚ताप्य mfn. to be inflamed or kindled, ŚBr.
सं-ताडन n. striking or dashing to pieces, ŚārṅgP.
सं-˚ताड्य mfn. to be forcibly struck or beaten, MBh.
सं-तार m. crossing, passing over or through (gen. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
सं-˚तारक mfn. conveying or helping over
सं-˚तारक—विधि m. N. of wk.
सं-˚तारित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to pass over, saved, rescued, delivered, R.
सं-˚तार्य mfn. to be crossed over or passed through (lit. and fig.), R.; Hariv. (v.l. for सं-धार्य).
सं-√ ताय् Pass. -ताय्यते, to be spread or stretched out, VS.

सं-√ तॄ P. -तरति (Ved. also -तिरति; rarely Ā.), to cross or traverse together, pass through (acc.), RV. &c. &c.; to escape or be rescued from (abl.), MBh.; Rājat.; to bring safely over, rescue, save, MBh. : Caus. -तारयति (Pass. -तार्यते), to cause to pass over, save or preserve from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: संतॄ — {c1c} P. 1 To cross over, traverse, travel over. --2 To swim, float. --3 To get over, overcome, surmount, go to the end of. --4 To reach, attain to. --5 To escape from, be saved.

m: सं-तीर्ण mfn. crossed or passed over &c.
saved or escaped from (abl.), MBh.

a: संतः — The two hands opened and the palms joined together.

m: सं-√ तक्ष् P. -तक्षति (rarely Ā. ˚ते), to cut out together, cut out, form or fashion by cutting, ŚrS.; VarBṛS.; to compose, construct (hymns), RV. ii, 31, 7; to cut through, cut to pieces, wound, MBh.; to hurt with words, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 76, Sch.
a: संतक्ष् — {c1c} P. 1 To pare off, chisel, chop. --2 To wound, hurt, strike; निस्त्रिंशाभ्यां सुतीक्ष्णाभ्यामन्योन्यं संततक्षतुः Mb.; Bṛ. S. 42. 29. --3 To hurt by words. --4 Ved. To compose (hymns &c.).

m: सं-तक्षण n. hurting with words (वाक्-स्˚ pl. ‘sarcasm’), Daś.
a: संतक्षणं — Sarcastic or cutting language, sarcasm.

m: सं-√ तम् P. ताम्यति, to be distressed, pine away, Gīt.
a: संतम् — {c4c} P. 1 To become exhausted. --2 To pine away, languish.

m: सं-तमक m. oppression or distress (in breathing; a form of asthma), Suśr.
a: संतमकः — Oppression or distress (in breathing &c.).

m: सं-तमस् n. great or universal darkness, W.
a: संतमस् — n., संतमसं 1 All-pervading or universal darkness, great darkness; निमज्जयन्संतमसे पराशयं N. 9. 98; Śi. 9. 22; Bk. 5. 2. --2 Great darkness or delusion of the mind (महामोह).

m: सं-˚तमस n. id.
great delusion of mind, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
सं-˚तमस mfn. darkened, clouded, W.

सं-√ तन् P. -तनोति (ind.p. -तानम्), to stretch along or over, cover, RV. &c. &c.; to unite or join one's self with (instr. or acc.), RV.; Lāṭy.; to join or connect or keep together, make continuous, TBr. &c. &c.; to add, annex, Vait.; to effect, accomplish, TS.; MuṇḍUp.; to exhibit, display, evince, Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -तानयति, to cause to extend or accomplish, cause to be finished, BhP.
a: संतन् — {c8c} U. 1 To stretch over, cover over, cover with. --2 To make continuous, connect together. --3 To effect, accomplish. --4 To show, display.

m: सं-तनि mfn. continuing, prolonging, forming an uninterrupted line or series, AitBr.; Lāṭy. &c.
सं-तनि m. f. sound, harmony, music, R.
a partic. oblation, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
सं-तनि n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
सं-˚तनिक n. du. (with प्रजापतेः) N. of a Sāman, ib.
सं-˚तनु m. N. of a youth attending on Rādhā, Pañcar.

सं-√ तप् P. -तपति, to heat thoroughly, scorch, parch, dry up, R.; Suśr.; VarBṛS. &c.; to feel pain or remorse, Mn.; MBh.; to pain by heat, torture, oppress, afflict, harass, RV. &c. &c.: Pass. -तप्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to be oppressed or afflicted, suffer pain, undergo penance (3. sg. impers. with gen. of pers.), ŚBr. &c. &c.: Caus. -तापयति (Pass. -ताप्यते), to cause to be heated, make very hot, burn, inflame, scorch, Kauś.; MBh. &c.; to pair by heat, torture, torment (आत्मानम्, ‘one's self. i.e. to afflict the body by austerities’), afflict, trouble, distress, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संतप् — {c1c} P. 1 To heat, warm; संतप्तचामीकर Bk. 3. 3; संतप्तायसि संस्थितस्य पयसो नामापि न ज्ञायते Bh. 2. 67. --2 To parch, dry up. --3 To pain by heat, torture. --Pass. 1 To become hot or heated. --2 To be distressed, suffer pain, be sorry; संतप्तानां त्वमसि शरणं Me. 7 ‘of the afflicted’; दिवापि मयि निष्क्रांते संतप्येते गुरू मम Mb.; Bh. 2. 87. --3 To repent, be stung with remorse; V. 3. 5. --4 To undergo penance, --Caus. 1 To heat, burn, inflame. --2 To provoke, exasperate, irritate. --3 To torment, torture, distress, afflict. --4 To burn up, consume. --5 To foment (quarrels &c.)

m: सं-तपन mfn. heating, warming, ĀpŚr., Sch.
the act of becoming warm, Kauś.
inflaming, tormenting, MW.
a: संतपनं — 1 Heating, inflaming. --2 Torturing.

m: सं-तप्˚तायस् n. heated or red-hot iron, Bhartṛ.
सं-तप्त mfn. greatly heated or inflamed, burnt up &c.
red-hot, molten, melted (see comp.)
oppressed, pained, tormented, distressed, wearied fatigued, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-तप्त n. pain, grief, sorrow, Mṛcch.
a: संतप्त — p. p. 1 Heated, inflamed, red-hot, glowing; Pt. 1. 250. --2 Distressed, afflicted, tormented. --3 Burnt, scorched. --4 Exhausted, fatigued, wearied. --Comp. --अयस् n. red-hot iron. --वक्षस् a. shortbreathed.

m: सं-तप्त—चामीकर n. glowing or molten gold, MW.
सं-तप्त—हृदय mfn. feeling great anguish of heart, R.
सं-तप्त—रजत n. molten silver, ib.
सं-तप्त—वक्षस् mfn. oppressed in the chest or breathing, short-breathed, Suśr.
सं-˚तप्यमान mfn. being inflamed or tormented or distressed, BhP.
सं-˚तप्यमान—मनस् mfn. one whose mind is in a state of torture, Vikr.
सं-√ तड् P. -ताडयति, to strike together or forcibly, hit hard, hit with (an arrow &c.), MBh.; Hariv.; R.; to beat or play a musical instrument, MBh.
सं-तरण &c. See सं-√ तॄ.
सं-तरण mfn. conveying over or across, bringing out of (a danger), VS.
सं-तरण n. the act of crossing over or passing through (comp.), R.
a: संतरणं — 1 Crossing over. --2 Surmounting.

m: सं-तरम् or सं-तराम् ind. (fr. 2. सम् + त्˚) more together, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.
सं-तर्दन m. N. of a son of Dhṛṣṭa-ketu, Pur.
सं-तर्दन n. the act of connecting or fastening together, Jaim.
सं-√ तर्ज् Caus. -तर्जयति, to threaten, abuse, scold, terrify, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-तर्जन mfn. threatening, abusing, reviling, Car.
सं-तर्जन m. N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh.
सं-तर्जन n. and f(आ). the act of threatening or reviling, MBh.; Kām.; BhP.
a: संतर्जनं — Threatening, reviling.

m: सं-˚तर्जित mfn. threatened, abused, scolded, reproved, W.
सं-√ तर्क् P. -तर्कयति, to consider or regard as (two acc.), MBh.
सं-˚तर्पणीय mfn. treating of restoratives, Car.
सं-˚तर्पण mfn. id., Kāv.; Suśr.
सं-˚तर्पण n. the act of satiating or refreshing, refreshment, R.
a means of strengthening, restorative, Suśr.
a partic. luscious dish (consisting of a mixture of grapes, pomegranates dates, plantains, sugar, flour, and ghee), L.
a: संतर्पणं — 1 Satisfying, satiating. --2 Gratifying, delighting. --3 That which gives delight. --4 A kind of sweet dish.

m: सं-तर्पक , ˚पण &c. See सम्-√ तृप्, col. 3.
सं-तर्पक mfn. satiating, refreshing, invigorating, Bhpr.
सं-˚तर्पित mfn. (fr. Caus.) satiated, satisfied, Dhūrtas.
सं-˚तर्प्य mfn. to be satiated or refreshed or gladdened, MBh.
सं-तरुत्र mfn. conveying across, effective, sufficient (as wealth), RV.
सं-त˚ताभ्यास m. habitual practice, regular study or repetition (of the Vedas &c.), W.
सं-त˚ताश्रु-निपातन n. continuous shedding of tears, R.
सं-त˚तापद् mfn. one whose misfortunes are continuous, ib.
सं-तत mfn. (cf. स-तत) stretched or extended along, spread over (loc.), PraśnUp.
covered with (instr.), MBh.; Hariv.; R.
held or linked or woven or sewn or strung together, dense, continuous, uninterrupted, lasting, eternal (ibc. or अम् ind. ‘continually, uninterruptedly, incessantly’), ŚBr. &c. &c.
a: संतत — p. p. 1 Stretched, extended. --2 Uninterrupted, continual, constant, regular. --3 Lasting, eternal. --4 Much, many. --तं ind. Always, continually, constantly, eternally, perpetually.

m: सं-तत—द्रुम mfn. (a wood) containing dense (rows of) trees, R.
सं-तत—ज्वर m. continuous fever, Suśr.
सं-ततम् (अम्), ind., ‘continually, uninterruptedly, incessantly’
सं-तत—वर्षिन् mfn. raining continuously, Dhūrtas.
सं-तत—वेपथु mfn. trembling all over, MW.
सं-ततेयु m. (fr. सं-तत) N. of a son of Raudrāśva (cf. सं-नतेयु), Pur.
सं-तति f. stretching or extending along, expanse, continuity, uninterruptedness, TS. &c. &c.
causal connection (of things), MBh. i, 291 (Nīlak.)
a continuous line or series or flow, heap, mass, multitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
density, intensity (of darkness), Rājat.
uninterrupted succession, lineage, race, progeny, offspring, Mn.; MBh. &c.
continued meditation (= धी-स्˚), Prab.
disposition, feeling, Divyāv.
= -होम, ŚBr.
N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kratu (cf. सं-नति), MārkP.
सं-तति m. N. of a son of Alarka, BhP.
a: संततिः — f. 1 Stretching across, spreading along. --2 Extent, expanse, extension. --3 Continuous line or flow, series, row, range, succession, continuity; चिंतासंततितंतुजालनिबिडस्यूतेव लग्ना प्रिया Māl. 5. 10; कुसुमसंततिसंततसंगिभिः Śi. 6. 36. --4 Perpetuation, uninterrupted continuance; निदानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्य संततेः R. 3. 1. --5 A race, lineage, family. --6 Offspring, progeny; सततिः शुद्धवंश्या हि परत्रेह च शर्मणे R. 1. 69. --7 A heap, mass; (अलं) सहसा संतीतमंहसां विहंतुं Ki. 5. 17.

m: सं-तति—होम m. N. of partic. sacrificial texts, TBr.
सं-˚ततिक (ifc.) = सं-तति, progeny, offspring, Kull. on Mn. iii, 15.
सं-तति—मत् mfn. possessing offspring, MārkP.
सं-तवीत्वत् mfn. (pr. p. of Intens. of सं-√ तु) one who has great power to effect or accomplish, able, capable, RV.
सं-तेजन n. sharpening (fig.), exciting, Suśr.
सं-तृण्ण mfn. joined or fastened together, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
hollowed out, perforated, ŚBr.
सं-√ तृद् P. Ā. -तृणत्ति, -तृन्त्ते, to fasten or tie together by means of a perforation (through which a peg or pin is passed), ŚBr.; Kāṭh.; ChUp.; to hollow out, perforate (see below).
सं-तृद्य mfn. to be joined together by pegs or fastenings (see above), ĀpŚr.

सं-√ तृप् P. -तृप्णोति, or -तृप्यति, to satiate or refresh one's self with (gen.), RV.; MBh. : Caus. -तर्पयति, to satiate, refresh, invigorate, gladden, delight, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; to feed on (instr.), Car.

a: संतिः — 1 End, destruction. --2 A gift; cf. सति.

m: सं-√ तिज् Caus. -तेजयति, to stir up, excite, arouse, MBh.; Bālar.
सं-तोदिन् mfn. striking, stinging, AV.
सं-तोषा (आ), f. N. of the mother of Gaṅgā-dāsa, Cat.
सं-तो˚षानन्द m. N. of an author, Cat.
सं-तोष m. (ifc. f(आ). ) satisfaction, contentedness with (instr. or loc.; ˚षं-√ कृ, ‘to be satisfied or contented’), MaitrUp.; MBh. &c.
Content (personified as a son of Dharma and Tuṣṭi and reckoned among the Tuṣitas q.v.), Prab.; Pur.
a: संतोषः — 1 Satisfaction, contentment; संतोष एव पुरुषस्य परं निधानं Subhāṣ. --2 Pleasure, delight, joy. --3 The thumb and fore-finger.

m: सं-˚तोषणीय mfn. to be gratified or propitiated (-रूप mfn. ‘one who has the semblance of being gr˚ or pr˚’), MBh.
सं-˚तोषणीय—रूप mfn., ‘one who has the semblance of being gr˚ or pr˚’
सं-˚तोषण n. the act of satisfying, propitiating, comforting, MBh.
a: संतोषणं — Pleasing, gratifying, comforting.

m: सं-˚तोषक mfn. satisfactory, gratifying, pleasing, MW.
सं-तोष—वत् mfn. satisfied, contented (in अ-स्˚), Pañcat.
सं-˚तोषिन् mfn. satisfied, contented, pleased with (comp.), Yājñ.; Śāntiś.; ŚārṅgP.
सं-˚तोषित mfn. (fr. Caus.) satisfied, pleased, comforted, Bhartṛ.; Rājat.
सं-˚तोष्टव्य mfn. to be satisfied or gratified (n. impers.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
सं-˚तोष्य mfn. to be contented or gratified, MBh.
सं-त्राण n. saving, rescuing, MārkP.
सं-त्रास mfn. great trembling, terror, fear of (abl., -तस्, or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
a: संत्रासः — Fear, terror, alarm.

m: सं-˚त्रासन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of terrifying, alarming, Chandom.
सं-˚त्रासित mfn. (fr. id.) made to tremble with fear, frightened, terrified, Bhaṭṭ.; Pañcat.
सं-त्रायति m. (used as a substantive to represent the above verb सं-√ त्रै), MBh. viii, 1992.
सं-√ त्रै (only inf. -त्रातुम्, but cf. below), to protect well or effectually, preserve, defend, MBh.
सं-√ त्रस् P. -त्रसति, or -त्रस्यति, to tremble all over, be greatly terrified or frightened, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -त्रासयति, to cause to tremble, frighten, terrify, ib.
a: संत्रस् — {c1c} {c4c} P. To fear, be afraid or terrified; Bk. 14. 39. --Caus. To frighten, terrify; Pt. 1. 197.

m: सं-त्रस्त mfn. trembling with fear, frightened, alarmed, MBh.
सं-त्रस्त—गोचर mfn. one who is looked at with terror, Car.
सं-√ तुद् P. -तुदति, to strike at, goad, sting, MBh.; (with प्ररोहान्) to put forth new sprouts i.e. recur again and again (as a disease), BhP.
सं-√ तुल् P. -तोलयति, to weigh one thing against another, balance together (also in the mind), MBh.

सं-√ तुष् P. -तुष्यति, to feel quite satisfied or contented, be pleased or delighted with, have great pleasure in (instr.; -तुष्य ind. ‘with joy, joyful’), MBh.; Kāv. &c. : Caus. -तोषयति (mc. also ˚ते), to make well satisfied or contented, propitiate, please, rejoice or present with (instr.)
a: संतुष् — {c4c} P. 1 To be pleased, satisfied or contented; संतुष्टो भार्यया भर्ता भर्त्रा भार्या तथैव च Ms. 3. 60; Bh. 3. 5; Bg. 3. 17. --2 To have great pleasure in. --Caus. 1 To satisfy, please, gratify. --2 To present with (anything).

m: सं-तुषित or सं-तुषि˚तक, m. N. of a Deva-putra, Lalit.
सं-तुष्ट mfn. quite satisfied or contented, well pleased or delighted with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संतुष्ट — p. p. Satisfied, pleased, contented.

m: सं-तुष्ट—तर्णक-वती f. (a cow) having an easily satisfied calf, Hcat.
सं-˚तुष्टि f. complete satisfaction, contentment with (instr.), MBh.; BhP.
a: संतुष्टिः — f. Complete satisfaction,

m: सं-त्व n. (fr. 2. सम्), TBr. (also w.r. for शन्त्व).
सं-√ त्वर् Ā. -त्वरते, to be in a great hurry, hasten, ŚBr. &c. &c.: Caus. -त्वरयति, to cause to hurry or hasten, urge on MBh.; R.
सं-त्वरा f. great haste, hurry, ĀśvŚr.
सं-˚त्वरित mfn. greatly hurried, hastening, MBh.; R.
सं-˚त्वरितम् ind. in a hurry, in great haste, quickly, ib.
सं-त्याग m. relinquishment, abandonment, renunciation, resignation, R.; MārkP.
सं-˚त्यागिन् mfn. relinquishing, leaving, abandoning, ib.
सं-˚त्याज्य mfn. to be left or abandoned or given up, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

सं-√ त्यज् P. -त्यजति, to relinquish altogether, abandon, leave, quit, desert, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to avoid, shun (दूरेण, ‘from afar’), Bhartṛ.; to give up, renounce, resign, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to withdraw from (an obligation), Yājñ. ii, 198; to yield, deliver up, Kathās.; BhP.; to leave alone, disregard, omit (-त्यज्य ind.p. ‘excepting’), VarBṛS.; Rājat. : Caus. -त्याजयति, to cause to abandon, deprive of (two acc.), MBh.; to rid of, free from (abl.), Bhaṭṭ.
a: संत्यज् — {c1c} P. 1 To abandon; जायामदोषामुत संत्यजामि R. 14. 34. --2 To avoid, shun; Bh. 1. 81. --3 To give up, renounce; Ms. 4. 181. --4 To except, exclude; संत्यज्य विक्रमादित्यं धैर्यमन्यत्र दुर्लभं Rāj. T. 3. 343. --Caus. To deprive (one) of, rob.

m: सं-त्यजन n. the act of entirely deserting or abandoning, W.
a: संत्यजनं — Leaving, renouncing.

m: सं-˚त्यज्य mfn. to be left or abandoned, MārkP.
सं-त्यक्त mfn. entirely relinquished or abandoned, left, R.
deprived or destitute of, wanting, lacking (instr. or comp.), VarBṛS.; Pañcat.
a: संत्यक्त — p. p. 1 Completely deserted or abandoned. --2 Robbed, deprived of.
